maddeler.e:
يتزلزل (form IIq)
# يَتَزَلْزَلُ (yatazalzalu) /ja.ta.zal.za.lu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of تَزَلْزَلَ (tazalzala)
# يُتَزَلْزَلُ (yutazalzalu) /ju.ta.zal.za.lu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of تَزَلْزَلَ (tazalzala)
# يَتَزَلْزَلَ (yatazalzala) /ja.ta.zal.za.la/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of تَزَ
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
